careers.title: Physical Therapist (DPT)
careers.roleSummary: Diagnoses movement dysfunction, designs rehabilitation programs, and restores physical function after injury or surgery.
educationPath: High School: Biology, Anatomy, Health Science

careers.title: Sports Scientist
careers.roleSummary: Uses data, biomechanics, and physiology to optimize athletic performance and reduce injury risk.
educationPath: Master s: Human Performance or Biomechanics

careers.title: Strength & Conditioning Coach
careers.roleSummary: Designs and supervises training programs to improve strength, speed, and power.

careers.title: Athletic Trainer
careers.roleSummary: Provides on-field emergency care, injury assessment, and rehabilitation for athletes.
